Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.label: T H E WO L F W H O L I V E S IN THE BIG HOUSE
Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.description: The Wolf will accept anything, and then devour everything, no matter what.

Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.label: Auclair, an acquaintance
Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.description: Auclair has a scholarly aspect and a morbid streak. [You might be able to recruit this acquaintance as a follower.]

Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.label: Auclair, a believer
Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.description: Auclair is quiet, meticulous and remorseless.

Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.label: Auclair, a disciple
Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.description: Auclair rarely speaks. She chooses her words with care. Even her movements have become economical. She is never seen to blink.

Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.label: A gaunt woman, who is silent.
Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.description: The air is frosty, the candles gutter, the street-sounds are hushed. Someone is here.

Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.label: Cat Caro, an acquaintance
Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.description: 'Cat Caro', as she styles herself, earns a living as a stage medium and a fortune-teller. She may have deeper talents. [You might be able to recruit this acquaintance as a follower.]

Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.label: Cat Caro, a believer
Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.description: A bright-eyed, watchful woman who recalls her dreams perfectly.

Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.label: Cat Caro, a disciple
Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.description: She still performs in the theatres sometimes. 'Cat Caro,' the posters say, 'finds the path; Cat Caro knows the way.'

Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.label: Cat Caro, a Seer
Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.description: Archaeologists find treasures in tombs. Farmers bring harvest from the fields. What does Cat Caro unearth in dreams?

Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.label: 'Pope' Clifton, an acquaintance
Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.description: A bellowing and unorthodox Catholic with a mystic streak and an untrimmed beard. [You might be able to recruit this acquaintance as a follower.]

Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.label: 'Pope' Clifton, a believer
Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.description: Now Clifton improvises new prayers rich with solar metaphors. He still shouts like a soldier and drinks like a sailor.

Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.label: 'Pope' Clifton, a disciple
Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.description: Clifton's devotions have grown complex. His eyes have grown wide and shining. His voice has become even louder.

Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.label: Clifton, a Seer
Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.description: Clifton still recites his prayers, but they are grown strange as old mirrors. He rises every morning to greet the dawn. He looks it full in the face, and tells you exactly what he sees.

Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.label: Clovette, an acquaintance
Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.description: Clovette is happy in a way that brooks no counter-argument to happiness. [You might be able to recruit this acquaintance as a follower.]

Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.label: Clovette, a believer
Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.description: Clovette's determined happiness now borders on the fanatical.

Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.label: Clovette, a disciple
Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.description: Clovette's optimism is daunting. She wields her joy like a hammer.

Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.label: Clovette, a Tarantellist
Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.description: Clovette is always in motion. She laughs easily. Her smile is the crescent at the edge of the moon.

Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.label: Connie, a disciple
Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.description: Connie's found one last gambit she couldn't resist... or perhaps she's just enjoying life.

Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.label: Connie, a Conqueress
Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.description: It's not in Connie's nature to serve. One day she'll rise as a river rises. But for now, she stoops to conquer.

Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.label: Dorothy, an acquaintance
Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.description: Dorothy is an enthusiastic sort with an eclectic reading habit. She's fascinated by my hints about the shapes beneath the world's skin. [You might be able to recruit this acquaintance as a follower.]

Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.label: Dorothy, a believer
Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.description: Dorothy is an enthusiastic sort, and I have turned her enthusiasm to our advantage.

Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.label: Dorothy, a disciple
Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.description: Dorothy's enthusiasm has become obsession. She will not cease; and how she loves to dance.

Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.label: Dorothy, a Tarantellist
Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.description: When Dorothy moves, we hear the drum. When she speaks, we see the dance. Her determination is her shield and her weapon.

Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.label: Douglas, a believer
Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.description: Douglas has exchanged the Force for the Forge.

Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.label: Douglas, a disciple
Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.description: Douglas doesn't like hammers. They remind him of an Incident. But he uses what instruments he must.

Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.label: Douglas, a Reshaper
Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.description: Douglas has changed so much. His eyes glow like smithy windows in fog. His voice is the rattle of coal in the chute. His arm is long.

Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.label: Elridge, an acquaintance
Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.description: An elegant man of inelegant habits. [You might be able to recruit this acquaintance as a follower.]

Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.label: Elridge, a believer
Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.description: Elridge has almost learnt not to pick his teeth with his knife in conversation. He has not yet learnt to leave his knife in his boot.

Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.label: Elridge, a disciple
Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.description: Elridge is waiting patiently until it's time to knife someone again.

Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.label: Elridge, an Assassin
Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.description: Elridge is never seen with a spot of blood upon his person. Not a spot.

Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.label: Enid, an acquaintance
Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.description: Enid speaks softly, and sometimes her gaze doesn't focus on anything visible. It may be that you've dreamed the same dreams. [You might be able to recruit this acquaintance as a follower.]

Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.label: Enid, a believer
Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.description: Enid speaks softly, and sometimes her gaze doesn't focus on anything visible. She sees things that others don't.

Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.label: Enid, a disciple
Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.description: Enid sees what others do not. It is becoming difficult for her, but it is very useful.

Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.label: Enid, a Key
Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.description: Enid sees the gaps between things, and the arts that she has learned permit her, sometimes, to place her fingers in that gap.

Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.label: Laidlaw, an acquaintance
Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.description: Laidlaw is a tinkerer and mechanic with an uncanny knack. [You might be able to recruit this acquaintance as a follower.]

Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.label: Laidlaw, a believer
Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.description: Laidlaw has begun to understand the limitations of ingenuity, and the power of sacrifice.

Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.label: Laidlaw, a disciple
Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.description: Laidlaw has learnt the cleverer uses of fire and copper, wax and acid.

Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.label: Laidlaw, a Reshaper
Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.description: Laidlaw can shape what is broken into what is necessary.

Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.label: Leo, an acquaintance
Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.description: Leo is an earnest sort with an interest in the occult. He hangs on your hints about the invisible arts. [You might be able to recruit this acquaintance as a follower.]

Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.label: Leo, a believer
Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.description: Leo is an earnest sort, but he's prepared to do what he must.

Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.label: Leo, a disciple
Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.description: Leo still yearns to preserve what is good and valuable; but he understands that to protect one's ideals, one must sometimes do questionable things.

Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.label: Leo, a Tarantellist
Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.description: Leo will preserve, at all costs. He will not cease.

Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.label: Natalia, a disciple
Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.description: Natalia never follows unquestioningly - but for now, she follows.

Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.label: Natalia, a Sage
Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.description: Natalia has aligned herself with the brightest path she can find.

Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.label: Neville, an acquaintance
Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.description: Neville pauses before he speaks, and flinches easily. He laughs whenever he thinks you've made a joke. [You might be able to recruit this acquaintance as a follower.]

Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.label: Neville, a believer
Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.description: Neville pauses before he speaks, and flinches easily. He's sensitive to deeper matters.

Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.label: Neville, a disciple
Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.description: Neville's gaze has grown furtive, and his voice is sometimes shrill. He speaks freely of his dreams.

Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.label: Neville, a Key
Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.description: In his dreams, Neville sees the flaws where the world and its ways can be opened.

Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.label: Porter, an acquaintance
Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.description: Porter was a barber, until the court case. [You might be able to recruit this acquaintance as a follower.]

Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.label: Porter, a believer
Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.description: Porter plies his razor and his scissors, to the great advantage of his friends.

Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.label: Porter, a disciple
Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.description: Porter goes unnoticed, until he's ready.

Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.label: Porter, a Skintwister
Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.description: Porter, like a spider, is found in the most unexpected places.

Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.label: Renira, an acquaintance
Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.description: Renira has been found not guilty three times in three separate jurisdictions. She will likely never be found guilty of anything. [You might be able to recruit this acquaintance as a follower.]

Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.label: Renira, a believer
Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.description: Renira continues to pursue her appetites discreetly, although her ambitions have grown.

Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.label: Renira, a disciple
Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.description: Renira commands admiration wherever she goes. She reserves her attentions for those who merit admiration in return.

Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.label: Renira, a Cyprian
Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.description: Renira receives tokens from admirers almost daily. Some gifts are flowers, others poetry. Sometimes she receives jewels; sometimes, desperate gifts wrapped tightly in blood-stained crepe paper.

Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.label: Rose, an acquaintance
Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.description: Rose is a sly miss, and she recognises you as someone uncommon. [You might be able to recruit this acquaintance as a follower.]

Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.label: Rose, a believer
Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.description: Rose is a sly miss, but loyal.

Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.label: Rose, a disciple
Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.description: Rose has sharpened her cunning to a concentrated point.

Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.label: Rose, an Assassin
Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.description: The night before Rose meets her subject, the subject will receive a package with a single yellow rose.

Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.label: Saliba, an acquaintance
Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.description: Saliba is a man of prodigious appetites. He is long past the point where their satisfaction has given him any pleasure; but he has learnt so very much. [You might be able to recruit this acquaintance as a follower.]

Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.label: Saliba, a believer
Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.description: Saliba understands blood. He does not yet understand birth.

Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.label: Saliba, a disciple
Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.description: Saliba's pleasures are taken in a room without windows. His companions return to him again and again, even though each time they are a little less.

Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.label: Saliba, a Cyprian
Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.description: Saliba's charisma strikes with the force of a hammer. It is horribly difficult to refuse his desires.

Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.label: Slee, an acquaintance
Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.description: Craig Slee, the astronomer and avant-garde poet, has developed an interest in the esoteric as his health wanes. [You might be able to recruit this acquaintance as a follower.]

Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.label: Slee, a believer
Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.description: Slee speaks earnestly of his theories to all who will listen: the stars as tiny wounds, and the Sun as a haemorrhage of glory. His poetry is more eccentric than ever.

Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.label: Slee, a disciple
Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.description: Slee's headaches have become crippling, but his theories grow more practical by the day. His poetry's getting better, too.

Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.label: Slee, a Seer
Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.description: Slee speaks exclusively in mathematics and in poetry. Both are compelling: it is increasingly difficult to tell the difference.

Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.label: Spencer, a disciple
Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.description: Spencer carries a tiny icon of St Agnes on a chain around his neck, to rest on the scar above his heart.

Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.label: Spencer, a Herald
Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.description: Some follow the Way, and some are the Way for others. Spencer no longer tells us he made a decision: instead, he suggests that the decision has made him.

Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.label: Sylvia, an acquaintance
Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.description: Sylvia lost her eye in the woods when she was nine years old. Every year, at Candlemas, she returns to the place she buried it. [You might be able to recruit this acquaintance as a follower.]

Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.label: Sylvia, a believer
Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.description: Sylvia has a detailed knowledge of roof-ridges, of the river at low tide, of Irish whiskey, and of conjuring tricks.

Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.label: Sylvia, a disciple
Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.description: Sylvia's favourite tactic is to smile and close her eye. It is remarkable how often her interlocutor will blurt out exactly what they are thinking.

Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.label: Sylvia, a Skintwister
Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.description: Sylvia has learnt to get out of a place almost before she has gotten in. Sometimes, she leaves dead leaves beneath the window-sill. Sometimes, she writes her name where it won't be found.

Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.label: Tristan, an acquaintance
Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.description: Tristan dislikes distractions. Tristan gets things done. [You might be able to recruit this acquaintance as a follower.]

Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.label: Tristan, a believer
Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.description: Tristan dislikes distractions; Tristan likes results.

Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.label: Tristan, a disciple
Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.description: Tristan will do what is necessary. To create, sometimes one must first destroy.

Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.label: Tristan, a Reshaper
Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.description: In another age, Tristan might have been a smith. In another life, he might have been a bomb-maker.

Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.label: Valciane, an acquaintance
Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.description: Valciane has operated her establishment for almost twenty years. She has never employed an assistant. Her hands are terribly strong. [You might be able to recruit this acquaintance as a follower.]

Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.label: Valciane, a believer
Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.description: Valciane's ingenuities are endless, and her grip is stronger than a blacksmith's.

Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.label: Valciane, a disciple
Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.description: Valciane is not a machine. We are reasonably confident of that, because she has been observed, now and then, to commit quite human errors.

Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.label: Valciane, a Reshaper
Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.description: Valciane has begun to work without tools. 'They get in the way,' she claims.

Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.label: Victor, an acquaintance
Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.description: Victor is a sly fellow, and he knows an unusual opportunity when he sees it. [You might be able to recruit this acquaintance as a follower.]

Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.label: Victor, a believer
Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.description: Victor is a sly fellow, but loyal.

Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.label: Victor, a disciple
Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.description: Victor has sharpened his cunning to a concentrated point.

Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.label: Victor, an Assassin
Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.description: Victor likes to become acquainted with his subjects, so he can apologise to them personally, just before the end.

Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.label: Violet, an acquaintance
Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.description: Violet has always given unstintingly of her time, easing the pain of the dying. [You might be able to recruit this acquaintance as a follower.]

Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.label: Violet, a believer
Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.description: Violet likes to paint. She has a gift, although she's always been very modest about it. She never puts human figures in her paintings. There are enough people in the world.

Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.label: Violet, a disciple
Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.description: Violet is always very careful.

Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.label: A kindly-faced woman, who is silent.
Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.description: Sleep, now. Don't worry about a thing.

Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.label: Ysabet, an acquaintance
Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.description: Ysabet has always been most comfortable by moonlight. She has excellent night vision. She is often overlooked in daylight. [You might be able to recruit this acquaintance as a follower.]

Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.label: Ysabet, a believer
Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.description: Ysabet sleeps in fits and starts. She rises at dusk to do the things an Ysabet does.

Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.label: Ysabet, a disciple
Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.description: Ysabet was just here, just a moment ago. Just here. Almost certainly.

Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.label: Ysabet, a Skintwister
Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.description: Ysabet never lies, now. She doesn't need to.

Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.label: Zachary, a disciple
Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.description: Zachary's reasoning is as certain as ever, but now, it is chillier.

Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.label: Zachary, a Conclusion
Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.description: Zachary has chosen his ending.

Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.label: A Hanger-On
Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.description: Usefully malleable, but they'll probably never amount to much. [You might be able to recruit this acquaintance as a follower.]

Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.label: A Hanger-On
Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.description: Usefully malleable, but they'll probably never amount to much. [You might be able to recruit this acquaintance as a follower.]

Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.label: A Pawn
Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.description: This one is loyal, but lacks initiative.

Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.label: A Sturdy Disciple
Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.description: Loyalty, and muscles.

Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.label: A Practical Disciple
Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.description: Loyal, and good with their hands.

Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.label: An Avid Disciple
Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.description: Loyal, but greedy.

Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.label: A Lively Disciple
Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.description: Loyal, and always ready with a song.

Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.label: A Dextrous Disciple
Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.description: Loyal, and clever with locks.

Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.label: A Percipient Disciple
Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.description: Loyal, and keen-sighted.

Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.label: An Erratic Disciple
Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.description: Loyal, if peculiar; peculiar even for one of our kind.

Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.label: A Silent Disciple
Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.description: Loyal, and quiet as falling snow.

Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.label: A Hulking Fellow
Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.description: 'I get the job done.' [This Hireling may be useful for some Expeditions, and can help with Hunters and Annoyances.]

Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.label: A Shifty Woman
Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.description: 'I get the job done.' [This Hireling may be useful for some Expeditions, and can help with Hunters and Annoyances.]

Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.label: Professional Muscle
Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.description: 'I'll break them in half.' [This Hireling may be useful for some Expeditions, and can help with Hunters and Annoyances.]

Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.label: A Bomb-Maker
Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.description: 'Perhaps we shouldn't discuss politics just yet.' [This Hireling may be useful for some Expeditions, and can help with Hunters and Annoyances.]

Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.label: An Entry Consultant
Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.description: 'I'm good with doors. [This Hireling may be useful for some Expeditions.]'

Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.label: A Fortune-Teller
Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.description: 'I see things. I see that you're different.' [This Hireling may be useful for some Expeditions, and can help with Hunters and Annoyances.]

Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.label: An Experienced Swindler
Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.description: 'How delightful to be working with you!' [This Hireling may be useful for some Expeditions, and can help with Hunters and Annoyances.]

Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.label: A Sturdy Worshipper
Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.description: Sometimes, Fervour drives laypeople to devote themselves to more uncommon duties. [When this one's enthusiasm fades, they will return to the congregation.]

Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.label: A Practical Worshipper
